lines.q: What force keeps your feet on the ground?
lines.a: Gravity! The same force keeps the Moon circling Earth.

lines.q: What is the centre of an atom called?
lines.a: The nucleus! Tiny, but it holds almost all of the atom's mass.
The pancreas! It sits tucked just behind your stomach.

lines.q: How long does moonlight take to reach Earth?
lines.a: About one point three seconds! Sunlight needs more than eight minutes.

lines.q: What is the largest organ inside your body?
lines.a: The liver! Your skin is bigger, but it's on the outside.

lines.q: Last one. Which colour of light has the longest wavelength?
lines.a: Red! Violet has the shortest. Think you got all six? Go again!
